configuration_definition.description: C13 with the Ovonic two-battery purchase unit shipped from an Australian warehouse and an XT60 battery connector, replacing the unverified HobbyKing pack

limitations: Historical option quantities are not installed quantities; only the explicit accounting manifest supplies installation and consumption.
Full minimum purchase packs/spools/lengths are charged; no equipment ownership is assumed.
Availability labels are review annotations, not independently verified supplier stock.
Supplier URLs, access dates, currencies, units and conflicts are preserved in each price_record; no current re-fetch is implied.
An empty unpriced list or reviewed annotation does not independently prove BOM completeness.
Known mass subtotal excludes unknown lines; a null total must not be used as a complete vehicle mass.
GSE mass is separate and never added to flight mass; contingency is charged to the vehicle without an invented hardware mass.
Above-ceiling gross or uncertain-tax totals do not alone prove the tax-exclusive requirement impossible.
No thermal, propulsion, CAD-clearance, battery-energy or flight-performance check is performed.

pricing.rounding: Round each line upward to AUD 0.01, then sum.

limitations: Values come from text extraction of the RBA page; the time-of-day basis of the USD row was not independently confirmed.
Card, bank or marketplace FX margins are excluded except in the sensitivity case.
Prices accessed on 2026-10-01 use the same conservative rate.
source.policy: Convert every USD price with the minimum listed USD-per-AUD value, giving the largest AUD amount.
source.source: Reserve Bank of Australia, Exchange Rates - Daily, table Units of Foreign Currencies per Australian Dollar, United States dollar row

pricing.tax_rule: Use printed ex-tax prices; documented_tax_exclusive additionally deducts recorded GST only where explicitly included. Never deduct tax from an unstated basis.

scope: Preliminary whole-purchase ledger and separately identified installed mass. Not completeness, procurement, mission or physical acceptance.
unpriced_gse_items: Compatible ExpressLRS transmitter, its required battery/power source and charging accessories; assume none owned.
4S-capable balance charger, required power supply/AC lead, XT60 charging lead and JST-XH balance connection accessories.
Battery charging/storage safety equipment and suitable guarded operating area provisions; no equipment ownership assumed.
Guarded coaxial thrust/torque test fixture, load cells, instrumentation amplifiers, calibration equipment and data acquisition.
RPM measurement, inline electrical power measurement, voltage/current meters and motor/ESC/battery temperature measurement equipment.
Assembly mass scale and equipment for CG/inertia and actuator travel/backlash measurements.
3D-printer access or fabrication service, soldering station and required reusable hand tools, cutting/drilling tools and measuring tools.
Computer/programming and logging interface, suitable USB/data cables and required adapters; do not assume an existing computer is available.
Restraints/tethers, guarding/netting and test-area equipment for staged ground and flight tests; specify suitability before costing.
unpriced_vehicle_items: Plain-shank gimbal pivot pins or shoulder screws, spacers and required retaining hardware; existing M3 screw packs do not establish suitable bearing interfaces.
Whole minimum purchase of solder and any separately required flux used in the vehicle; soldering equipment is separate GSE, but incorporated consumables are not automatically excluded.
Whole minimum purchases of required heat-shrink, electrical insulation/sleeving, strain relief and connector retention materials.
Required thread-locking compound, adhesive, washers or alternative anti-loosening hardware after the joint design is established.
Controller/sensor male headers and mating connectors not demonstrably included in purchased kits.
Any required ADC filtering/protection, decoupling, power regulation or independent inhibit hardware identified by the electrical-interface review.
Any additional propeller adapter or positive-retention hardware needed after confirming the included collets and adapter rings.
Any additional fairing, sensor shielding, isolation, feet or mounting material not supplied by the existing purchased stock; rocket-shape and complete CAD coverage are unresolved.
